絶対にインストールするな！

title: Little Shops
content: The five-stars is for real! What I found is that Temu consists of many little shops that you’re purchasing from. So, yes, the items are made and shipped from China, BUT, I like the fact that I’m supporting many “little shops” instead of just big stores like the U.S. has. What I have learned is that there are many of these little shops that sell “fakes”, or replicas of the same well-made item at another little store on Temu. (So Temu is similar to EBay, but without bidding, and much more affordable!) You may want to make a list of the stores you get good items from, so when you reorder, you don’t get a non-legit item (or fake). I have fun just adding cool things to my Wishlist: on item, scroll down, passed the reviews, and you’ll see the little empty heart and “wishlist “ by that. Tap heart to save in your wishlist.

title: Read carefully the descriptions
content:
Not happy with Temu.  A lot of cheap and poor quality goods that look good in photos but are generally a lot smaller than pictured.  A lot of unfair marketing practices encouraging people to buy more.  4 items for free, but after selecting my choices I then he ad to purchase a lot of goods to obtain the free items.  When buying the required items and paying for them I then discovered that I would only receive one free item and would have to make further purchases on another day to get the next item free. A big con as I tested this buy adding further items to a certain amount to my basket only to be offer a small discount of less than £2 with no mention of the next free item.    In all fairness, some of the items I have purchased have been good quality at a fair price but also a lot of rubbish goods.  Yesterday I received a batch of 50 paint brushes plainly showing 1” on the metal binding but only measure just under 20mm and the laughable part is that there was more loose bristles in the delivery bag than there was in the brushes.  They went straight into my rubbish bin.
Best tip I can offer is double read and study the description before buying especially delivery times as some items will be shipped overland from the other side of the planet.
Happy shopping and be careful.

title: Bislang eine sehr positive Erfahrung
content:
Die erste Bestellung vor ein paar Monaten war mit eher gedämpften Erwartungen verbunden. Den ersten positiven Eindruck machte die Möglichkeit, über Klarna mit Monatsfrist bezahlen zu können. So ist man bei ausbleibender Lieferung auf der sicheren Seite.
Die Lieferung kam schließlich pünktlich und mängelfrei (!) zum vorausgesagten Zeitpunkt.
Die Qualität der Ware hat mich vor allem in Hinblick auf die unschlagbar günstigen Preise absolut überzeugt. Sie entsprechen auch weitgehend den Beschreibungen.
Inzwischen haben wir schon mehrere Einkäufe bei Temu gemacht. Immer mit der gleich guten Erfahrung einer zeitgerechten Lieferung aller bestellten Artikel in einer Sendung. Bisher war alles frei von Mängeln und es musste nichts zurück geschickt werden. Ich habe daher die Zahlungen stets gleich nach Lieferung freigegeben.
Anfangs noch recht misstrauisch, bin ich heute angenehm überzeugt und zufrieden.

title: A welcome surprise amidst rising costs!
content: Like many of you, I was sceptical about buying anything from them after reading so many reviews that painted a negative picture. I installed the app a year ago and during that time I’ve probably purchased over 1000 items, and in all that time only needed to request a refund on 1 damaged item. The app itself is intuitively designed to gamify receipt of discounts, but even the least astute user will quickly recognise the model of gamification used is “everyone’s a winner” - I doubt it would have been as successful 20-30 years ago, but it does hook you, and again to reiterate - I’ve had some amazing deals, spent far too much money, and if you are a fellow ADHDer I hope you have more discipline and self-control than I do! Giving it 5 stars for all round cost-saving, blatant targeting of neurodivergent shoppers, but selling items that have brought moments of hilarity, enabled me to buy bespoke gifts for staff in the office, and I now own a collection of Pixel light sabres for a fraction of the cost. So many sellers are local stockists in the UK, so I’ve even had items arrive within 2 working days - and for those larger items being sent by land, keep an eye on the tracking updates as there’s nothing quite like realising the banjo you’ve purchased has had visited more countries than you have!! In seriousness, set limits on what you’re spending, take advantage of the cash back offers - they really do work as promised, you just need to complete daily logins to complete the rewards in full. Final thought - if you want pristine packaging and levels of presentation that reflect what you might expect from high street store purchases in the UK, then this retailer and app probably isn’t for you!

title: Preis Leistung Unschlagbar
content:
Ich persönlich habe sehr gute Erfahrungen mit Temu gemacht. Die Preise sind super und auch einige Angebote und Aktionen lohnen sich, wenn man sie schlau einsetzt. Der Kundenservice ist immer bemüht und durch den Transport beschädigte Teile, werden ersetzt oder erstattet. Bin sehr zufrieden mit Temu. Wie bei jedem  anderen Anbieter auch, gibt es bei Temu auch Dinge die manchmal nerven oder keine super überzeugende Qualität haben. Die Lieferungen dauern länger als beim großen A, allerdings ist es auch deutlich günstiger und der Kunden Support ist bei Temu meiner Erfahrung nach deutlich kulanter und man merkt, dass Temu die Kunden sehr wichtig sind.
Gerade bei Möbeln war ich erst skeptisch, aber nach 3 Erfolgreich aufgebauten kleinen Möbeln, bin ich sehr überzeugt von Qualität und Preis.
Ich werde Temu eine Treue Kundin bleiben und empfehle Temu gerne weiter 👍🏼😊

title: Sells anything and everything.
content: Site is easy to navigate, has a feature to take a picture of a product you are looking for and the app will locate all the sellers on the site selling it. Again I found to copy and paste a product detail in the search also lets you find the best price for a product you have seen listed. Many sellers sell the same product and at varying prices. If you hold product in your basket for a number of days sometimes and offer comes up for just those products. The vouchers are good also and you earn those with purchases. On the whole the site is good, be aware the things shipped by land can take a long time but smaller items and those sold locally are dispatched quickly. The site is updated regularly by Temu but is reliant on the couriers to give accurate information, for the many many purchase I have made the delivery times are realistic and they do give a voucher if they exceed promised delivery time. Customer service are polite but slow and limited on what they can actually assist you with to sort a problem, they basically record detail and generate a “ticket” for their superiors to deal will and this again takes time. It can be very frustrating at time the slow process and if anything I thing this should be improved. This is a very honest review of Temu and if your wondering I would say try it and I think you will be hooked 😄 read produced detail and materials used thoughtfully and will save disappointments.

title: Sharing the Love
content: I am an Aerospace, Electronic/Mechanical Engineer. I’ve tinkered with tools and items since I could walk. I took apart my parents vacuum cleaner at 5. Got in bad trouble. We grew up without. So…I put it back together. Now on an early retirement opportunity, I have designed my new shop and garage. 99.9% of it, Literally floor to ceiling. Including the floor and ceilings. I have purchased hundreds of items for thousands of dollars. I am completely astonished. Temu offers some of the best special tooling for every need. I can dream, design, acquire materials, and fabricate to almost fix or make anything. I have found tools made better than the big names out here. PENNIES ON THE DOLLAR. I replace my older stuff with the new Temu items I like. And selectively choose what to keep and forward along to kids, g babies, friends, etc. Temu has kinda re-programmed me from DOD Facilities to my own playroom/mancave. I even got a great deal on some mobility scooters. I bought 7. 6 came in perfect. One was broke, Temu CS and Seller fixed that in minutes. I live in a tourist town. I rented these 6 scooters for 7days and they paid for themselves and are now making money hand over fist with no effort. These scooters are now disposal and I’ll just keep 6 going on for now. They are work horses so I’m hoping to make some money to pay for everything I’ve bought recently! This is not a coached review. This is truly reopened my young kid and my life’s work again. Thanks Temu!

title: Great for deals if you choose carefully
content:
Temu sells a lot of stuff, and a lot of it is heavily discounted. Unfortunately there are a lot of counterfeits or very poor quality items that you might end up buying, but if you take the time to look through the reviews and see what other people have mentioned about it, it helps narrow down the choice for high quality choices.

Also some of Temu’s promotions are very solid in return value, while some of them are downright not worth it at all. Always look into the “free items” or “returned credits” conditions to get a clearer idea of what you’re getting in return. Personally I like the returned as credit promotions, and the free item ones usually aren’t that great unless it’s exactly what you were looking for. With the return in credits, you can use the credits to purchase what you were actually interested in.

Bonus tip: if you find a promotion that is actually worth it, like spend 65-75 dollars and get 50 dollar worth of credits back over 7 days, Temu usually only lets you choose from an infinite scrolling list in the promotions. A small way around that is to make sure you have all the items you were interested/ vetted to make sure they were reputable first loaded into your cart. Temu’s infinite scrolling will give you random choices but the algorithm is catered to items you’ve looked up or normally purchase, so if you happen to see that reputable item that is currently in your main cart, you know it’s a solid buy that you can add to the promotion’s cart.

title: 95% Happy!
content:
I am new to Temu. For the past couple of months I kinda went nuts with the tax refund & got so many nice things for very little cost-and several free items.
To get the best of what Temu has to offer, I highly recommend the following-
It is important to read the store reviews, the product reviews, look at the photos & videos sent in by purchasers, read the description of the product IN FULL! 2D means flat-for those that don't know-I've seen you on tiktok, lol. Check the measurements-because the one pictured is usually the biggest they carry & there's several choices for sizes (for wall hangings, clothes, drapes, figurines-everything!) The prices are amazing, and if you shop right, your purchases will be too! I opened one box today that I was awe struck by-honestly. It was a caligraphy set with green (fake but pretty) big rhinestones, a feather, several inks of different colors, a feathered caligraphy pen and a non feathered one, a wax stamp, with waxes of many colors, an ink holder and pen holder made from brass. It is so beautiful & was under $20... just checked-it was $10!! Be careful and follow my tried and true plan. Only got two items I wasn't happy with-1 was free-normally the free stuff is fine & the other was some hanger for leggings that cost a buck. No biggy. I have gotten so many items and am 95% happy with my purchases. Happy with the delivery time, as well. For those with shopping addictions-do not follow the buy more and get more - they got me a couple times-but I felt me & my kiddo deserved our items. 🙂❤️✌🏼

title: Tolle Angebote, Super App + Service
content:
Das alles kann ich garnicht alles beschreiben, die App ist bahnbrechend!  Das bemerkt man beim Stöbern. Der Aufbau der App ist sehr übersichtlich gestaltet, es werden produkttechnisch sofort weitere Alternativen angeboten. Die Produktbeschreibungen sind ausführlich und zutreffend. Sehr positiv fällt mir auf, dass es zu den Leitlinien der Produktgrösse bei Bekleidung zwei Tabellen gibt, die auch zutreffen! title: Not as bad as I expected.
content: I heard a lot of people say that this app is a scam, and while I can certainly see why they’d think that it actually isn’t a bad place to shop. I will deduct it a star though for one reason; they give you the illusion that you’re winning prizes. When you spin a wheel or pull the lever on a virtual slot machine they will ALWAYS rig it to have the best prize to make you think you got lucky, and they do this to pressure you into taking the deal before it expires. Sometimes they even have promotions where they offer you free items if you invite friends to the app or the event, don’t believe this though since they made this nearly impossible to win. They do have some games on this app where you water a plant or feed some fish for a while, which can actually get you some free items, granted they are cheap items but still free regardless. And I’m not referring to the ones you choose the moment you play the game for the first time, I mean the extra items they allow you to earn on the side. They make it to where you need to complete the side objective every day of one week to get it, which doesn’t really take up much of your time for each day you gotta do this. When it comes to the actual shopping, the prices are actually really good. I would recommend talking to their customer service bot about getting the checkout minimum removed though to make things more convenient for you. Anyway, that about sums this review, it’s a surprisingly fun app to shop on.

title: Ok.. could be better
content:
You can find anything and everything on Temu. The thing is, it is not going to of top notch quality. Items are rather cheap in both aspects. Some items I’ve gotten have been great. But a lot of others have been terrible. My packages always arrive damaged and it’s not uncommon to receive wrong items or sizes or not receive all items ordered. But Temu has been great about refunds and return for all orders that weren’t correct or came damaged or defective.

There are opportunities to run free items. You just have to go through hoops. If you know a lot of people that don’t already have Temu then you should be able to take advantage of and benefit from the free gift tasks. There are also always promos. Some are good and some not so much. The rules are not ever defined before you accept the promo. Also, you do get coupons but they’re never really worth it anymore. When I first started purchasing from Temu the coupons and the promos were great. Either it was only for new customers or they’ve made a lot of changes and it’s affected customer rewards.
There are games inside Temu that you can play to earn free items. But don’t think it will be easy or a quick process. It is at first until you get to .05 cents give or take a FEW cents. Then it seems nearly impossible to complete the requirements.
I am on Temu a lot just looking at stuff. I do find it interesting all of the items they have. I’ve made several purchases and I’ve only received a mascara for free. So it’s not as advertised.

title: Addictive but incredible. Please read for details
content: There are a lot of things being said about Temu right now, but I have done an extensive search amongst my friends for someone who has experienced these issues personally and I have not found anyone. So as long as you don’t mind reading the small print and using common sense you can and will have good fun with the seemingly endless supply of goods available. I have heard all the stories about how Temu is the Chinese government coming to steal your money and spy on you. Well I guess they have definitely had enough money but I have mountains of clothes and household goods and very little that I would return. If I have a problem it’s usually down to my not being careful in my choosing and failing to pay attention to the size which is usually displayed. Also once you choose keep your eyes open you can usually find cheaper if you scroll down. Then Temu will refund you the difference in price if something you bought drops in price. I don’t know if anyone else does that. I LOVE TEMU, and the only blip I have had is an order that I didn’t place was placed and now I have contacted them and awaiting confirmation of the refund. They have responded quickly and I have every confidence that they will get this resolved ASAP. I must say how quickly they deliver most items and they are top notch at keeping you up to date with their orders. They are much quicker than say Wholee used to be. I am delighted with the Temu app and experience and watch this space for updates on my refund and how long it took. So far the response from Temu is excellent, they are quick and friendly and understanding about someone who is willing but not very able when it comes to shopping online.

Overall, Temu's lack of transparency and poor user experience make it a regrettable choice for anyone seeking affordable shopping options.

title: Erstbestellung hat mich überzeugt
content:
Insgesamt habe ich vier Produkte bestellt. Eine Fleecemütze (leider etwas klein-gab es nur in Einheitsgröße), 5 T-Shirts als Unterhemden, 2 Sport T-Shirts und eine Hundedecke zur Abdeckung unseres Betts.

Von der Qualität war ich positiv überrascht. Die T-Shirts passen perfekt und lassen sich angenehm tragen. Den 80% Rabatt für die erste Bestellung hat sich für mich voll gelohnt. Wenn sich das bei weiteren Bestellungen bestätigt, werde ich dort regelmäßig bestellen. Die Lieferzeit mit 10 Tagen war für mich auch akzeptabel, da ich von vornherein wusste, dass die Lieferung aus China kommt. Auch war ich über den Sendungsverlauf immer informiert und konnte hier sehen, dass die Lieferung nicht per Schiff, sondern per Luftfracht nach Europa kam und von der Niederlande zu mir nach Hause geliefert kam.

Nach dieser ersten Erfahrung ist TEMU eine Empfehlung. Allerdings hatte ich aufgrund von Erfahrungen mit anderen Internetanbieter aus China durchaus etwas „Bauchgrummeln“.

title: Great service.
content: The delivery and returns is very good, the clothing I have bought is really good quality and sizing is just about spot on for me. The jewellery I have bought it's cheap and looks great for one wear stones fallout and it also arrives with stones missing. CCTV camera was great arrived with no memory card and cost £44 to watch on smart phone, CCTV door bell needs constantly charging up so no use, selfie stick arrived great but didn't work. Somethings are great but also somethings are a load of rubbish. It's also so cheap I've not bothered sending stuff back got a draw full of stuff that I should have really sent back instead it will end up in the bin. One other thing they bombard you with offer's,  emails, WhatsApp, text messages send you offers which when you try to use them you have to send more and more and end up with 2p off your order. If you leave something in your basket you get messages to death telling you your basket is calling. Do not be drawn in as when you look at the basket you end up filling it again and again. I have spent over £1000 quid in three months I have now blocked everything except emails as it's turned into an addiction. Be warned but the clothes are really well made and look good on.

title: Tolle Seite zum bestellen der verrücktesten Sachen
content:

Dadurch wurde auch ich geködert😏 und habe mir auch 5 Geschenke ausgesucht. Meistens bei den letzten 0,80€ bin ich gescheitert🤷‍♀️man hatte mindestens 8- 10 Leute die mitgemacht haben und es klappte damit immer noch nicht. Sehr ärgerlich. Vielleicht sollte man selber entscheiden können, wieviele Gratisgeschenke man möchte, eine Wahl zwischen 1 und 5 Geschenken.
Nichts desto Trotz bleibe ich bei Temu, weil es wirklich total tolle und preiswerte Dinge gibt.

title: DON’T MISS OUT
content:
First of all, if you haven't used app yet make sure to enter the reward coupon «3️⃣3️⃣0️⃣3️⃣4️⃣9️⃣3️⃣7️⃣0️⃣» on the sign up screen to get a $100 bonus! I have spent about $150 so far on Temu. I have loved everything so far except for one thing and I have probably bought 30 items. I was pleasantly surprised with the quality of most things. Some were better than others but for the price I sure can't complain. I will be back for sure. You can't lose even if one thing turns out not so great because it is so inexpensive. The shipping is fast for what is probably coming from over seas. maybe a week or little more.

They will text you a lot of times with updates on your order so you are never left in the dark wondering where your package is. I love getting a deal so Temu is my kind of place to shop. I recommend looking around on the site for the best deal because many times they will have it cheaper from a different seller suppose because there are multiples of similar items. They also send you coupons sometimes. If you have friend who you can sign up you can get a lot of free stuff but I didn't want to bother anyone. I like to wait til they send me a coupon to place an order. Try it you will like it. Warning most the time when they offer free gifts you are going to have to get friends to sign up and you will play games to get the points then you will need more points to win and you will need more points to win and you will need friends to sign up to actually win the prizes you have!!
